title: The Local Hopf Problem on S^2 x S^2
description:
Computer-assisted proof that metrics of positive sectional curvature on S2 × S2 converge in C∞ to the product of round metrics, answering Bettiol's Local Hopf Problem I.

The archive contains the proof (proof/PROOF.md), the article (paper/local-hopf.tex and paper/local-hopf.pdf), and the verification code with logs (verification/): exact computations over Q(t,r) and a ball-arithmetic certificate.
